reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: validateDataColumnSidecar (gossip_validation.nim:586-716) calls verify_data_column_sidecar (peerdas_helpers.nim:352-366), which only checks kzg_commitments.len > 0 and array length consistency, but does NOT validate against epoch-specific max_blobs_per_block. In contrast, validateBeaconBlock correctly enforces this check at lines 383-388 using get_blob_parameters(epoch).MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK. An attacker can send a data column sidecar via P2P gossip with excessive kzg_commitments (e.g., 100 when epoch limit is 6) that passes all validation checks. The attack path is exploitable: sidecars propagate via gossip before block validation, so inconsistent state can persist until block arrival. Severity calibrated to Medium per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json severity thresholds: Nimbus has ~15% client share (below 33% High threshold), and this affects all nodes receiving gossip. 01e property PROP-6a4369e9-inv-009 (01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json:227-242) explicitly requires: 'kzg_commitments count must not exceed max_blobs_per_block for the sidecar's epoch' with assertion 'forall sidecar: len(sidecar.kzg_commitments) <= get_blob_parameters(epoch).max_blobs_per_block'. Code violates this spec requirement.
